title: What to Know about Those Vaccines

reader_summary.headline: I'm sharing one of our recent 16 minutes episodes here, since it covers COVID vaccines.
reader_summary.overview: I'm sharing one of our recent 16 minutes episodes here, since it covers COVID vaccines, a topic that's top of mind for everyone. So we wanted to make sure that everyone had access to it in this feed, where we've long covered the coronavirus pandemic since very early on. And we also answer some questions in this episode that actually applied to both recent vaccine announcements.

key_points.text: As a reminder, this is our show where we talk about the news, tease apart what's hype, what's real in the headlines.
key_points.evidence_quote: As a reminder, this is our show where we talk about the news, tease apart what's hype, what's real in the headlines, or in this case, quote, science by press release, and we always cover where we are in the long arc of innovation beyond the news, why it matters now.

key_points.text: In the episode that follows, we broke down the Pfizer and Beyond Tech News and specifically what the phase three interim trial means.
key_points.evidence_quote: In the episode that follows, we broke down the Pfizer and Beyond Tech News and specifically what the phase three interim trial means, the difference between vaccine efficacy and efficiency, and the significance of mRNA vaccines now and in the future.
